$docs.$self: Stillpoint Builders is a construction franchise, not a shop. Every legacy commerce and growth flag in brand.json `features` is false, so LEGACY_FLAG_MODULE_MAP (packages/module-kit/src/registry.ts) contributes nothing: no catalog, no ordering, no drops, no stored value. multi_location is true and deliberately unmapped -- it is a capacity setting on the brands row, not a capability -- so it adds no module either.
$docs.construction-projects: What this tenant actually runs, and the module the construction blueprint (industries/construction/blueprint.json) recommends first. It has no dependencies and reaches only the staff surfaces, which is why a tenant with no location, no menu and no commerce shape still resolves.
$docs.workforce-training: The blueprint's other recommendation. Left out on purpose: a recommendation is not an entitlement, and nothing in brand.json or on disk says this tenant runs training yet.
